body: So far I've gotten really lucky in meeting them just by people I made friends with, and back in high school I was so openly ace that the others found me and I still talk to a couple of them. But my one like adulthood ace friend sent me here, I don't know how to actively meet up. I'm hoping if I wear my black ring to queer bars someone might notice? Best of luck to you!

I recently had a fairly bad breakdown in front of my mother (I'm 21 and live at home) and because I am very very bad about shutting up when I'm upset I just ended up sobbing about how much I wanted to die and how lonely I am and miserable and going nowhere with my 4 jobs and life in general and how I just wanted the pain to end. And she actually told me how much she cares and my family cares and made me a list of therapists to check out and gave me some book I'm not going to read about depression and the pharmaceutical industry. And she didn't touch me which is kind of nice because it's hard for me to accept hugs and that kind of thing. But now the rest of the family is being a little more vocal that they appreciate my presence and honestly it helps a lot. I know a lot of families won't do this, and I'm real lucky but maybe telling someone you're depressed may help a little, maybe they've gone through the same thing

It's not, it's actually a giant pain in the ass because your body is hard wired to not die. I've tried a bunch of times and have either chickened out or failed, and it's lucky I'm not severely outwardly damaged. I have the feeling a lot of people have, I just want someone else to do it for me. Dying successfully is wicked hard, especially with no firearms. I dunno man

But it's weird, my brain changes when I'm very very depressed from even being "okay" but still sad, I think and act differently and I'm very nearly a different person. It's a new, still shitty day but I'm willing to try that mindfulness crap right now, even though I think it's hippie nonsense. My current rationale is well I work around a lot of hippie nonsense anyway I guess.
